info.title: TollBit API
info.description: TollBit is the web stack for the agentic internet: publishers analyze, control, and monetize AI agent access to their content. This API lets developers and AI agents discover licensable content (Licensed Search), fetch rates and license options, mint one-time signed access tokens, retrieve licensed or indexed content, self-report usage, and list a property's content catalog. Reconstructed by API Evangelist from TollBit's published per-operation OpenAPI fragments (docs.tollbit.com/reference).

x-apievangelist.source: https://docs.tollbit.com/reference (per-operation OpenAPI fragments merged; llms.txt index)
x-apievangelist.note: Reconstructed from TollBit's published per-operation OpenAPI 3.0 fragments. Only real /dev/* and subdomain endpoints included; a foreign ReadMe sample spec present on two reference pages was excluded.

tags.description: A financing represents the conditions of a financial agreement between a merchant and R2. A financing is instantiated once a merchant is approved upon a successful KYC process, a contract is signed by both parties, and funds are successfully disbursed to a merchant's bank account.

tags.description: A merchant is a business that sells electronically in your platform. A merchant is the entity that R2 evaluates from a risk standpoint and provides capital to, should the merchant be preapproved and interested in receiving a financing.
tags.name: merchants

parameters.description: Comma-separated list of domains (max 20) to boost in search results. When provided, generates a custom goggle string.

parameters.name: allowedOnly
parameters.description:
When true, restrict search to properties the calling org is allowed to access.
Intersects with `properties` when both are provided.
Currently mirrors `readyToLicense`; will be expanded to broader allowlist semantics later.

parameters.name: readyToLicense
parameters.description: When true, restrict search to properties ready to license (rates-enabled / content-catalog path). Intersects with `properties` when both are provided. Currently equivalent to `allowedOnly`.

SubdomainAccessToken.description:
To access content on a TollBit subdomain, you will need an access token. This token is a JWT that is signed by TollBit and includes information about the subdomain and the permissions granted to the token.

You can obtain the token by calling the TokensService to create a Content Access Token. Once you have the token, you can include it in the Authorization header of your requests to the subdomain.
